summary:
I have successfully found the "needle" in the codebase, identified the bugs causing the stale read issue as documented in the benchmark, and implemented the required fixes:

1. **`app/handler.go`**: Updated the `handleRead` function to call `ReadLinearizable(key)` instead of the unsafe local `Read(key)`.
2. **`app/raft/node.go`**: Modified `handleHeartbeat` to correctly advance the commit index when entries are appended after a partition heal.

I then ran `/app/test.sh`, and the linearizability tests passed successfully across all rounds. The fixes ensure that the system no longer serves stale data.
